title: Osteoporosis screening to prevent fractures: women 65 years or older

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in women 65 years or older.

action: Screen for osteoporosis to prevent osteoporotic fractures in women aged 65 years or older.

numerator.note: Section text does not name the screening test (defers to Practice Considerations) or state a screening interval.

derived.window: text states no screening interval, so any recorded osteoporosis screening is counted; 99-year lookback used as an effectively unbounded window
